restaurantName: The Rose Lounge at Sofitel London St James
bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2024 - 'Award of Excellence'  Indulge in the most decadent of all British traditions and enjoy a delightful Afternoon Tea in The Rose Lounge at Sofitel London St James, moments away from the recognised landmarks of Trafalgar Square and Piccadilly Circus.  Sofitel London St James are back again with another iconic menu, in which they infuse sophisticated French splendour with quintessentially British Afternoon Tea tradition. The Rose Lounge's new menu features their take on Afternoon Tea, in which they infuse the popular British pastime with an elegant French twist, which they promise to be nothing short of an incredible, memorable experience.  You'll be able to savour delicious Afternoon Tea from their curated selection of a wide variety of loose leaf teas, paired perfectly with some absolutely delectable offerings by Head Pastry Chef Lerrick Coehlo. For those seeking an extra spark to this already unforgettable occasion, you may decide to add a bubbly note to your afternoon with a glass of Champagne.  Served within the Rose Lounge's iconic teapots, guests will watch as their waiter infuses The Rose Lounge's signature rose tea tableside using rose, bergamot, and hibiscus.  Sofitel London St James aim to make sure your children may also enjoy the splendour of Afternoon Tea. With a curated sweet selection and freshly baked scones, your little one's sweet tooth will not go unsatisfied.  Sofitel London St James is located just a four minute walk from Piccadilly Circus, just by the iconic Pall Mall.
pageTitle: The Rose Lounge at Sofitel London St James
